integrity: The proof explicitly classifies kernel and non-kernel conjugacy classes, proves the adjacency criterion, and reduces invariable two-generation to existence of a cyclic module vector. The multiplicity-free criterion follows from the semisimple commutative module decomposition. The packaged replay independently enumerates conjugacy classes and all representative pairs in five finite examples.
scientific_limitations: The complement is cyclic and acts fixed-point-freely on the nonzero elementary-abelian kernel.
The theorem resolves the published connectivity question only for this Frobenius family.
General semidirect-product invariable-generation criteria already exist; the originality claim is the exact graph classification and conjugacy-class count.
title: Complete bipartite invariable-generation graphs of elementary-abelian cyclic Frobenius groups
